name: Loopline (meal-prep subscription)
brief: Loopline delivers pre-portioned meal kits to college students in a 10-minute pickup window between classes. We compete on speed and price, not gourmet ingredients.

name: Northstone Capital (fintech for freelancers)
brief: Northstone Capital is a banking app built for freelancers who have irregular income. We auto-split incoming payments into tax, savings, and spend buckets.

name: Verdant (indoor plant care app)
brief: Verdant is a plant-identification and watering-reminder app for first-time plant owners who keep killing their houseplants. Friendly, forgiving tone, not a horticulture textbook.
tagline: Keep it alive. We'll remind you.

name: Hearthline (senior check-in calls)
brief: Hearthline pairs isolated seniors with trained volunteer callers for a 15-minute weekly check-in call, with family members able to see a wellness summary afterward.

name: Pigeon (anonymous campus feedback)
brief: Pigeon lets students send anonymous feedback directly to professors and TAs mid-semester instead of waiting for end-of-term evaluations that never change anything.
tagline: Say it now, not in December.
